notes.title: v1.2.1
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Fixed leaderboard toggle during Campaign world select breaking menu navigation
[*] Fixed exiting level from pause menu breaking leaderboard score downloading
[/list]

notes.title: v1.2.0
notes.content:
[list]
[*]Added in-game leaderboard view
[*]Added OST filtering toggle
[*]Fixed misspelling in options menu
[*]Extra life animation no longer displays more lives than max
[/list]

notes.title: v1.1.2
notes.content:
[list]
[*]Fullscreen is now triggered on startup, rather than during main menu initialisation
[*]Fullscreen toggle hotkey now affects options menu setting
[*]Menus no longer block Alt+Enter fullscreen toggle hotkey
[*]Menu background is now reset to default when exiting campaign menu if hovered world is locked
[/list]

notes.title: V1.1.1
notes.content: Emergency fix: camera dampening being enabled no longer breaks initial camera position on certain maps.

notes.title: v1.1.0
notes.content:
[list]
[*]Added camera dampening settings
[*]Added fullscreen toggle to options menu
[*]Added blur toggle to options menu
[*]Added dither-band toggle to options menu
[*]Increased right stick pivot angle
[*]Fixed GOAL!!! achievement not requiring you to enter a goal
[*]Right trigger now also enables octolock
[/list]

notes.title: v1.0.3
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Removed starting platform gems on PIPE-NIGHTMARE
[*] Added missing gems and removed redundant geo from BOWL-DROP
[*] Player can no longer toggle pause menu when very close to a goal - this should prevent being able to reset as you hit the goal in order to cause a 0.0 second time
[/list]

notes.title: v1.0.2
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Fixed Campaign results screen SFX playing at the incorrect time
[*] Increased minimum gold medal time for ASCENDANCE (some players were experiencing hand pain)
[/list]
